Seems nice so far. Made an appointment for my cat Tiggy. They has to schedule almost a month away.

This vet clinic is amazing. I brought my cat in for some dental care and they went above and beyond. Their staff is very kind, understanding, patient, and professional. They were very knowledgeable and took great care of my cat. The attention and care he received was fantastic. If you're looking for a clinic with great staff and reasonable prices, this is the place to go.

If you make an appointment with this place you better make sure you're on time or 15 minutes earlier because if you show up 5 minutes late 10 minutes late 6 minutes late they will turn you away these people are rude have no consideration but yet they expect you to hold on the phone for 15 minutes will never come to this place again I don't recommend it to anyone

Terrible customer service. They always say they're very busy, but it's clear they don't want to work. They try to schedule appointments so long you won't come back, and when you call, they always put you on hold... Does anyone know of another place where they actually like to welcome and care for my dog?
Thank you for the great review. It really means a lot to us when our clients and pets feel that they are treated with kindness and respect.
We are thrilled to hear that you and your pet are happy with our service. We will do our best to not let you and your pet down in the future.

Thank you for the review. The walls are finally going up now and we are so excited. We'll post some photos of the progress.

Thank you for the great review. Pets do require yearly vaccinations, preventative medications and yearly checkups and tests- not to mention food and other necessities. It does add up. We want to keep our costs reasonable so that pet owners can afford the care that their pet needs.

We took our male cat here to get neutered and I was very impressed with the professionalism and care he received. The staff was so helpful and kind. Dr. Patricia McFaul did an incredible job on our cats surgery. He was home the same day and had no issues recovering. I would highly recommend Las Palmas Pet Clinic to anyone who wants top notch professional care for their pet.
Tell us how to make you sure about our services. We really would like to earn the fifth star from you and make you a regular client here.
Thank you for the great review. Owning a pet can get expensive but we try to keep our prices reasonable so every pet gets the service they need.

Thank you for the great review. We will do our best to keep the trust you
have placed in us and keep you as a valued client.
Thank you for the great review. It means a lot to us to know that we are treating our patients and their owners as well as they deserve.

I love this vets clinic. The people are very friendly with my dog. The doctor, Patricia McFaul is very serious about the care she gives, as I saw with the care she and her assistants who work there gave to my dog. I've taken my Old English bulldog (Maalum) to her since she was a couple of months old and still do to this day. I feel the clinic gives a personal feel to the treatment of my pet and I definitely recommended the clinic to anybody else who has a animal and wants a good result of treatment for their pet.
